objective: Determine whether raw-field rotational structures in the Mach-2.7 Euler/slip cylinder wake persist under spatial-grid and solver-time-step controls.
trajectory_grouping: Each complete run is one case-level, leakage-free trajectory group; snapshots from a trajectory must never be split between train and test.

common_parameters.physics: two-dimensional compressible Euler with a slip immersed cylinder

factor_isolation.spatial_grid_at_matched_dt: Compare f90/CFL=0.10 with f180/CFL=0.20; both use dt=0.0003003003003003003.

required_raw_field_tests: omega_z, lambda_ci, and Gamma_2 after geometry, 0.08D wall-band, and dilated-shock exclusion
signed object tracks, lifetimes, paths, and convection speeds
wake-probe transverse-velocity and pressure spectra on a common late-time window
track and spectral stability across the baseline, grid control, and time-step control
decision_rule: Do not claim Euler shock-generated vortex shedding unless alternating signed tracks persist and a common Strouhal peak remains stable under both controls. Otherwise report rotational wake candidates or numerical sensitivity evidence.
ground_truth_warning: The Euler/slip cylinder contains no viscous vortex-shedding ground truth. ML vortex outputs remain candidates until the full control matrix is audited.
